scope: ui.hub.skills.*: download, unpull, unpull_title, unpull_body, unpull_failed, subscribe_failed, local_path, published_by, not_downloaded, subscribed_absent, pulled, manual, detached (13 keys) audited against English ui.hub.json

findings.note: The active masculine past tense assumes the publisher is a man; {publisher} is an arbitrary user or organisation name from the hub, so a woman's name or a team name renders ungrammatically. The impersonal "Опубликовано {publisher}" (or "Издатель: {publisher}") is gender-neutral.

The button and the states it produces use different verbs: this key says "Скачать", while pulled/not_downloaded say "Загружено"/"Не загружено", and the same button's aria-label is pull_title "Загрузить {item} из {source}". Align on the hub's existing "загрузить" family.

findings.current: Файлы покинут папку навыков. Связь и подписка сохранятся, поэтому повторная загрузка вернёт текущую ревизию.
findings.proposed: Файлы покинут вашу папку навыков. Связь и подписка сохранятся, поэтому повторная загрузка вернёт текущую ревизию.
findings.note: The English says "your skills folder"; the possessive is dropped, losing the personal reference in a confirmation dialog.
